en.title: Maximum Strictly Increasing Adjacent Positions After Rearranging
en.description:
Rearrange all the integers in any order to maximize the number of adjacent positions with a[i]<a[i+1]. This is not the longest increasing subsequence.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains the scores. 2≤n≤200000, 1≤score≤200000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 2 and 0; in the second example the arrangement 1,2,1,2 rises at positions 0 and 2, and the source's 0 and 1 is wrong.
hints: The answer is n minus the maximum number of occurrences of a single value.
